style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, warm light
motion_rule: HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, and never leaves it; no window ends on an impact or a planted pose; a moving prop alone never counts; the camera never carries a window alone; new shot size every window
camera_moves: macro 0.0, low 0.6, 3/4 1.55, low tracking 2.7, wide 3.4, floor 4.2, over him 6.5, wide 9.5
character: a plump velvet mole, tiny eyes, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty, utterly serious
props: CALCULATOR: chunky cream plastic, BLANK buttons and BLANK screen. CHEST: a battered trunk, iron bands, a loose ring that rings. BOOTS: two split boots. HAT: a crushed felt hat
prop_continuity: the calculator never lights up; the ringing comes from the earth and the chest ring
environment: a round burrow, roots overhead, packed soil floor
lighting: bright light from a hole above, dust motes lit, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec, never drawn out
audio.pacing: speech 0.6-3.4 and 4.2-6.5 with one break; voiceless after 6.5, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable
audio.sfx: a dry plastic click, one dull iron chime under the floor at 3.6, more spreading through the walls, the burrow ringing by 6.5, the lid banging out of frame, a wall caving in at 9.7

timeline.a: silent. He bursts out of the soil wall and hurls himself across the whole frame, the blank calculator in one paw, clods flying
he charges left to right along the burrow, his whole body crossing the frame, roots whipping over his back
he runs up the curved wall and round it head down, his body sweeping the frame edge to edge, roots raking the lens
skidding on, he smashes the big blank button in passing; nothing lights, the recoil flinging him and the dead calculator on across the frame
silent. The calculator stays dead. The floor rings and caves in under him and he hurls himself the whole width of the burrow onto solid soil, the floor dropping away behind his heels, earth blasting
he claws up the collapsing wall, his body climbing the whole frame bottom to top, soil pouring past him
he loses the wall and tumbles head over heels across the floor edge to edge
silent from now on. He digs like a machine, his body driving down into the floor, earth blasting into the lens
silent. He hauls the chest out of the soil and drags it the whole width of the burrow, ring clanging
silent. He rips the lid up and flings it out of frame; inside two split boots and a crushed felt hat
silent. He jams the hat on, his shoulders drop, the brim slides over his eyes and he blunders over the chest across the frame
silent. Flat on his back he jams that same blank button again; the wall behind him caves in over him and buries the frame

must_appear: the calculator blank, him in frame at 3.4 as the floor drops away, the first chime from under the FLOOR not the device, boots and a crushed hat in the chest, the hat over his eyes, him pressing that same button again at the end
negative_prompt: black bands, letterbox, speech bubble, comic balloon, caption box, digits, letters, cyrillic, a lit calculator screen, coins, gold, subtitles, watermark, night, dim light, people, a second mole, slow motion, a pivot in place, the mole leaving the frame, a window where only a prop moves, a static wide at the end, any voice after 6.5, silence in the tail, drawn-out delivery
